open_semantics: Define the supported historical company/instrument scope; the first-trading workbook contains non-company fund instruments as well as equities.
Resolve whether each Delisting Date is the last tradable day or the first excluded day before deriving half-open valid_to.
Validate old/new ticker price continuity around dated code changes before fetching historical execution prices.
rules: Do not derive historical membership from core.universe_stocks or any other current snapshot.
Do not invent raw file URLs, column mappings, delisting date semantics, or ticker lineage.
Hash each downloaded raw file before transformation and retain the hash as provenance.
Canonical output must pass src.ingest.historical_universe.records_from_frame before persistence.
Temporary suspensions/tradability gaps are not proven by listing/delisting data; execution-day price/readiness gates remain authoritative for missing tradeability evidence.
